content.short: Evocardano is a token that will be launched on the BSC (Binance Smart Chain) network, but with the Project itself destined for Cardano's network.
content.description:
Where after the Alonzo update, the negotiation of Defi's projects on the blockchain will be allowed. Where it is believed in the possibility of eliminating bugs and hacks in DeFi's projects.

With that, comes an Evocardano, which is the development of a DEX - (Decentralized Exchange) similar to Pancakeswap for the Cardano network. Where to allow users to trade assets, Defi's projects on Cardano's network quickly, cheaply and securely.
